item.title: Nimbus Labs releases open-weight language model built for on-device coding assistants
item.description:
Nimbus Labs has published an open-weight language model designed to run locally on laptops, aimed at developers who want code completion without sending source code to the cloud.

The company says the model supports 12 programming languages.

item.title: Quantacore raises $40 million Series B to scale photonic chip production
item.description: Photonic computing startup Quantacore has raised $40 million in a Series B round to expand manufacturing of its light-based AI accelerator chips. The post Quantacore raises $40 million appeared first on Demo Tech Wire.
